scope: Optimistic scalar-entropy comparison: equal-area parallel-sector merger shock then isentropic compression to prescribed hot densities. It does not deliver actual positions/velocities, certify grain shock homogenization, or predict burn yield.
model: Frankfurt FEOS16.7 Thomas-Fermi/Cowan/bonding, no Maxwell/softsphere, plus equilibrium radiation. 300K reference and2GPa bulk modulus arechosenpolymerparameters.
limitations: Thomas-Fermi misses discrete shell structure; compare FPEOS contact states.
FEOS published source emits compilerwarnings including legacy mismatched new/delete; no library qualification claimed.
Ideal reversible compression is a lower entropy bound; later shocks/3D asymmetry can add entropy.
Mapped uniform entropy is only compared at original spatialdensityprofile; totalenergy restoration and new hydro would be subsequent tests.
